A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same PositionIC paper and complete six-page supplementary material. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that PDF pages 2–16 are identical. Page 1 differs only in the code/data access statement, arXiv stamp, and local text wrapping.

before.justification: v4 reports original DreamBench and PositionIC-Bench evaluations, a user study, and ablations in Tables 1–4 and Figures 7–9 and 14.

after.justification: v5 retains the same original benchmark evaluations, user-study findings, and main-text and supplementary ablation results.

M1.justification: The BMPDS synthesis/filtering pipeline, PositionIC architecture, visibility-aware attention, and volumetric weight regulation are unchanged in Section 3 and the supplementary material.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same Subject200K, PIC-400K/PIC-98K, DreamBench, and PositionIC-Bench coverage. Single-subject, multi-subject, spatial-control, and supplementary demonstration scenarios are unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is identical in the quantitative, qualitative, and user-study comparisons. For example, Table 3 retains RPF, MS-Diffusion, Instance-Diffusion, and Gligen.

E3.justification: Training schedules, model configuration, evaluation metrics, and sample sizes are unchanged. Both retain the 252 single-subject and 296 multi-subject benchmark samples and the subject-cropping evaluation procedure described in supplementary Section 9.

E4.justification: The data-filter, volumetric-weight-regulation, and visibility-aware-attention ablations are identical. The subject-size metric analysis in Figure 13 and supplementary qualitative analyses are also retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Statistical reporting is unchanged, including averaging scores from six user-study evaluators. Neither version reports repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: All numerical and qualitative results are identical, including supplementary results. For example, Table 1 retains PositionIC's CLIP-I/CLIP-T/DINO scores of 0.846/0.269/0.823, and Table 3 retains single-subject IoU 0.828 and multi-subject mIoU 0.860.

T1.justification: Equations (1)–(8) and their mathematical explanations are unchanged, including volume rendering, attention masking, and the supplementary semantic-density formula.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same scientific contributions and performance claims concerning BMPDS, spatial/identity decoupling, and controllable customization. The resource-access edit does not alter those claims.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning filtering quality, attention focusing, occlusion handling, and metric sensitivity to subject size are unchanged. No substantive limitations or applicability qualifications are added or removed.

D1.justification: The abstract replaces 'Code and data will be publicly released' with an explicit GitHub repository address, MeiGen-AI/PositionIC. This adds actionable access information; implementation details remain unchanged. The PDFs alone do not verify repository contents or availability.

R1.justification: The same 42 references, related-work discussion, and novelty positioning are retained. The added project repository address is resource-access information rather than a new related-work citation.

P1.justification: The final abstract sentence is revised to provide the repository address, and the arXiv version/date stamp is updated. The remaining prose, terminology, and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The repository address causes limited line rewrapping within the page-1 abstract. Figures 1–17, Tables 1–4, their captions and placement remain unchanged; PDF pages 2–16 render identically.

improvement.justification: Replacing a future-release promise with an explicit repository address modestly improves resource discoverability and reproducibility documentation. Scientific content and supporting evidence are unchanged. This benefit concerns the information supplied in the paper; actual resource availability and completeness cannot be established from the PDFs.
